items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Bing Crosby sang Three Little Words with the three Kings... Duke asked Crosby to see if he could make a record out of it

ctx.x: That was for "Check and Doublecheck." Do you remember anything else about Check and Doublecheck? ""

Bing Crosby sang Three Little Words with the three Kings, you know? Remember that trio that Bing Crosby used to sing with years and years ago. What did they call themselves? The Three Rhythm Kings, or something.
